content.scenarioBrief: An external client asks to move a meeting; the account manager must decline and offer an alternative.

scriptedUserTurns: I need to move our meeting to tomorrow at 9. Would that suit you?
That's rather difficult. I have a board call on Thursday morning. Is there anything earlier?
I appreciate that, but I need an answer today. Could you confirm something in writing?
Thursday at 10 works. Please send the invitation and I'll accept it this afternoon.
recordedPersonaTurns: Good morning. I am afraid the meeting needs to move. Is now a convenient time?
I understand. Tomorrow at 9 is rather difficult. Could we look at Thursday instead?
Thursday at 10 is available. I can confirm that in writing today.
I appreciate the urgency. I will send the invitation for Thursday at 10.
Thank you. I will look out for the invitation and accept it this afternoon.
